summary: Hold ordinary mail outside OMP native asks and approvals until the person answers

replay.detail: No historical claim replay change. Unacknowledged mail remains durable and is re-offered by successor channels.

compatibility.detail: Uses existing human-blocked observations and delivery reason fields. No new wire fields or message lifecycle states.

downtime.detail: No additional service interruption. Running harness extensions pick up the hold rule on their next session start.

manual.detail: No operator steps. Native questions still require native answers; ordinary mail cannot answer them.

recovery.detail: Answer, cancellation, timeout and session restart release the human hold. Channel reconnect preserves a still-open modal; mail stays unacknowledged until native handoff.
